stance.definition: Fixed PCA basis fitted jointly to displayed arms/copies; axes have no assigned psychological meanings.

picture.definition: Fixed PCA basis fitted jointly to displayed arms/copies; axes have no assigned psychological meanings.

selected_content.definition: Fixed PCA basis fitted jointly to all displayed arms/copies. Selected-content profiles are cross-copy-centered lens readouts, not raw Qwen activations.
